stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Sylvie enchants C-20 and makes her kill two of her own Minutemen. She then holds C-20 captive and mines her memories for the location of the Time-Keepers.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter X-5 brushes Mobius off at the TVA, then deserts and hides on the Sacred Timeline as the actor Brad Wolfe. Mobius tracks him down at a movie premiere and pesters him about a sequel before Loki blocks his escape.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Sylvie once enchanted Hunter X-5 and freed him from the TVA. He later sells her out to Ravonna Renslayer.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter X-5 travels to 1893 with Ravonna Renslayer to seize Victor Timely.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett recruits billionaire Ian Quinn to fund his plans. Quinn later works for him again after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After Ian Quinn shoots Skye, Melinda May storms into his cell on the Bus and beats him senseless.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson leads the raid on Ian Quinn's mansion in Malta to rescue the kidnapped Franklin Hall. Later his team captures Quinn after he shoots Skye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina and Ian Quinn work together on John Garrett's side in the Centipede project. When Garrett's mind starts to slip, they decide to take the Gravitonium and leave HYDRA together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Soon after they leave HYDRA, Raina betrays Quinn. She opens the Gravitonium's container and watches it swallow him, telling him it wanted him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kingo is Ikaris's longtime friend. When Ikaris betrays the team, Kingo refuses to fight him or to side with him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: When Kro nearly kills Sprite in London, Ikaris drives him off with his eye beams. In Alaska, Ikaris secretly throws Ajak down onto the ice where Kro's pack is waiting, leaving her to die so the Emergence can go ahead.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Makkari fights beside Ikaris for thousands of years and races around the Domo to help him find Sersi. When he betrays the Eternals to let the Emergence happen, she fights him at superspeed.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ikaris and Sersi bring Phastos back into the Eternals from his life in Chicago, where Phastos's son calls Ikaris Superman. When Ikaris betrays them, Phastos fights him, yet still keeps Kro from absorbing Ikaris's power.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ikaris is Sersi's ex-husband. He turns out to be loyal to Arishem and fights her to let the Emergence happen, then flies into the sun in shame.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite and Ikaris are fellow Eternals, and she has quietly loved him for thousands of years without him returning it. She sides with him against the others, and in the end he flies into the sun.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Thena fights beside Ikaris against the Deviants for thousands of years, and he tells her it is an honor to fight alongside her. When he betrays the Eternals to let the Emergence happen, she turns her weapons on him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley is a close friend of Lance Hunter who brings him into Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D., and the two run mercenary jobs together with Idaho. Hunter survives the car crash that kills her and wants revenge on Carl Creel for her death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley's mercenary team works with May after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, and May covers them with an I.C.E.R. when a deal goes wrong. Together they break into a government warehouse to recover the Obelisk.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Nick Fury orders Isabelle Hartley and Bobbi Morse to rescue Robert Gonzales aboard the Iliad.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Isabelle Hartley's mercenary team, not knowing she is secretly spying for Robert Gonzales. He sends her to recover a mysterious object that turns out to be the Obelisk, and she dies on that mission.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley fights her way through Hydra agents to rescue Robert Gonzales during the battle for the Iliad, and then serves in his S.H.I.E.L.D. He later sends her, Bobbi Morse, and Mack to infiltrate Coulson's organization.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley and Victoria Hand are close friends, and Hand trusts her more than almost any other agent. During the Hydra Uprising, Hand calls Hartley to tell her the Hub is secure.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Joaquin Torres befriends Isaiah through Sam Wilson. He rides with Isaiah to the White House summit and teaches him how to use AirDrop.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson seeks out Isaiah, a forgotten Black super soldier, and the two grow close. Sam has Isaiah's story added to the Captain America exhibit.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: When Isaiah is jailed after the White House attack, Sam fights to clear his friend's name.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Samuel Sterns plants a mind-control trigger in Isaiah and uses it to make him attack President Ross.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Under Samuel Sterns' mind control, Isaiah shoots at President Thaddeus Ross during a White House summit and is jailed for it.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Ivan Vanko takes control of James Rhodes's War Machine armor and turns it against Tony Stark.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Justin Hammer breaks Ivan Vanko out of prison to build weapons for him, and Vanko turns his work against Hammer's plans.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: When Ivan Vanko attacks Tony Stark at the Monaco race, Pepper Potts and Happy Hogan ram him with their car and pin him to a wall. Pepper then gets Tony his suitcase armor so he can finish the fight.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Ivan Vanko attacks Tony Stark at the Monaco Grand Prix with electric whips. Later he builds the drones that come after Tony at the Stark Expo.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After revealing Spider-Man's identity, J. Jonah Jameson also exposes Michelle Jones as Peter's girlfriend and accomplice.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson broadcasts Quentin Beck's doctored video, which frames Spider-Man and reveals his identity.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After revealing Spider-Man's identity, J. Jonah Jameson also exposes Ned Leeds as Peter's friend and dismisses his side of the story.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson brands Spider-Man a menace and reveals to the world that he is Peter Parker.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Riva sends J. Jonah Jameson the edited footage of Mysterio's last battle, which Jameson broadcasts to the world.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark creates J.A.R.V.I.S., the AI that runs his home and his suits.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., and part of J.A.R.V.I.S. goes on to become Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is created partly from J.A.R.V.I.S.'s code, so the A.I. that ran Tony Stark's life becomes part of a new being along with the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen Page helps free Jack Duquesne from Fisk's prison as part of Daredevil's resistance.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kate Bishop distrusts Jack Duquesne, her mother's fiance, and suspects him of murder. She learns her mother framed him, and the two end up on friendly terms.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie is Jack Duquesne's lawyer. She visits him in custody to prepare for his trial.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Daredevil breaks Jack Duquesne out of Fisk's prison and hands him a piece of rebar to fight the Anti-Vigilante Task Force at his side. Matt's law firm also takes on Duquesne's case.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Jack Duquesne tells Mayor Wilson Fisk to his face that he dislikes his policies. After he takes up the vigilante name Swordsman, Fisk's men lock him away in a secret prison.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Jack Murdock is Maggie Grace's former lover and the father of her son Matt.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Jack Murdock is Matt's father, a boxer killed by the mob for refusing to throw a fight.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins serves on the S.H.I.E.L.D. strike team that retakes the Lemurian Star with Natasha and Steve. When Hydra surfaces, his team captures her, Steve and Sam.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins serves on the S.H.I.E.L.D. STRIKE team that works under Steve Rogers. When HYDRA is exposed, Rollins joins the elevator ambush on Steve and later holds a rifle to his head after his capture.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Ted, the creature known as Man-Thing, is Jack's close friend. Jack enters the Bloodstone hunt to rescue him.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jack Russell poses as one of the monster hunters to rescue his friend Ted. When the hunters find out he is a werewolf, they turn on him.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa Bloodstone runs the hunt at Bloodstone Manor. When she learns Jack is a werewolf, she tries to kill him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson brings Johann Fennhoff, posing as the defector Dr. Ivchenko, back to New York after their mission in Russia. Fennhoff turns the SSR against itself, and during the raid on Stark's warehouse he knocks Thompson out.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jack Thompson goes to Whitney Frost to tell her the Gamma Cannon is not ready, and her partner Joseph Manfredi calls him stupid and threatens him. Thompson is really stringing them along for Vernon Masters.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson is the SSR's star agent and treats Peggy Carter like a secretary, then becomes her chief after Dooley dies. He comes to respect her after their mission in Russia, though he still takes the credit for her work.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Thompson runs the SSR in New York while Peggy works the Los Angeles office. He goes along with Vernon Masters and tries to bury Peggy's case against the Council of Nine, then turns on Masters and helps her stop Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ray Krzeminski and Jack Thompson are fellow SSR agents in New York who work the Howard Stark case together. Thompson is shaken when Krzeminski is murdered.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley runs the SSR's New York office, and Jack Thompson is the agent he trusts to lead the Howard Stark investigation. After Dooley dies, Thompson takes his place as chief.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters, a friend of Jack Thompson's father, pulls strings to get Jack his SSR job after the war and later brings him into his political circle. When Jack turns against him, Masters sends his men to kill him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jack Thompson works with Whitney Frost and the Council of Nine for a time.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Spider-Man interrupts Jackson Brice's weapons sale to Aaron Davis, and Brice, wearing the Shocker gauntlet, punches him across the street before fleeing. The chase leaves behind the Chitauri energy core that Peter and Ned later study.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Jackson Brice and Phineas Mason are friends and crewmates in Adrian Toomes' salvage crew, which turns to crime after Damage Control takes their work. Phineas builds the gauntlet Jackson wields as the first Shocker.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Jackson Brice was the original Shocker in Adrian Toomes's crew. Toomes accidentally kills him with a gun he thinks is an anti-gravity gun.

stages.title: All Hail the King
stages.text: Jackson Norriss poses as a documentary filmmaker to interview Trevor Slattery in prison. Then he reveals he is there to take him to the real Mandarin.

stages.title: All Hail the King
stages.text: Jackson Norriss is a Ten Rings agent who serves Xu Wenwu, the real leader behind the Mandarin name. After Trevor Slattery mocks that legend, Norriss poses as a documentary filmmaker to get him out of Seagate prison and deliver him to his master.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Melinda May takes up the Berserker Staff when its rage overwhelms Grant Ward, and she uses its strength to defeat Petra Larsen and the last of the pagan cult.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Luke is James Lucas's son. He resents his father for abandoning him, but he forgives him in the end.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Justin Hammer fits James Rhodes's War Machine armor with his own weapons.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes and Natasha Romanoff fight side by side against Ultron in Sokovia, and both join the new Avengers.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Natasha are among the few Avengers left, and they keep working side by side from the Avengers compound.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: James Rhodes and Nebula team up on the Time Heist, traveling to Morag in 2014 to steal the Power Stone. When Nebula is captured by the past Thanos, Rhodey has to return home with the Stone without her.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: James Rhodes and Pepper Potts are Tony Stark's two closest friends and often worry about him together.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rhodey and Pepper both fight in the Battle of Earth, and he is at her side when Tony dies.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Raava replaces James Rhodes and impersonates him for years. Fury eventually exposes and kills her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes and Sam Wilson join the new Avengers together after the fight in Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey and Sam end up on opposite sides over the Sokovia Accords. Rhodey is chasing Sam at the Leipzig airport when Vision accidentally shoots him down.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Rhodey and Sam are friends again, and after Sam gives up Steve's shield, Rhodey talks frankly with him about it.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes joins the new Avengers under Steve Rogers after Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey signs the Sokovia Accords and fights Steve's side at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos' forces come for Vision, Rhodey defies the Accords and fights beside Steve again to defend Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: James Rhodes backs Secretary Thaddeus Ross and the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos' forces come for Vision, Rhodey defies Ross and walks out to help the Avengers, knowing it means a court martial.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: James Rhodes is Tony Stark's best friend, a U.S. Air Force officer who stands by him for years.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: When Tony gets drunk at his birthday party, Rhodey puts on one of his suits to stop him and hands it to the military, where it becomes War Machine. They patch things up and fight side by side against Vanko's drones.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey stands with Tony behind the Sokovia Accords. When a misfired beam from Vision leaves him paralyzed, Tony builds him braces so he can walk again.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision and James Rhodes are fellow Avengers who both back the Sokovia Accords. At the Leipzig airport Vision's misfired beam knocks Rhodey out of the sky, leaving him paralyzed.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley arranges the defense of John Healy, a hitman working for Wilson Fisk, by paying Nelson and Murdock to represent him. The move keeps Healy's link to Fisk hidden while he stands trial.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley, Fisk's right-hand man, kidnaps Karen to threaten her into silence. She grabs his gun and shoots him dead.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley speaks for Wilson Fisk in meetings with Madame Gao and the other partners in his criminal alliance. He is the only one at the table who understands her when she jokes in Chinese.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley is Wilson Fisk's right-hand man, who brings Matt and Foggy a client as a front for Fisk's plans.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley passes Fisk's orders to Melvin Potter, who makes Fisk's suits.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley handles Wilson Fisk's dealings with Nobu Yoshioka, who represents the Hand in Fisk's criminal alliance. Wesley is never sure what Nobu's people actually contribute, even though they take an equal share of the profits.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley pays Turk Barrett for feeding a story to Vladimir Ranskahov.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley looks after Vanessa for Fisk and keeps her close to the business. She relies on him when Fisk breaks down.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley deals with the Ranskahov brothers for Fisk, then works to wipe out Vladimir's operation.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley is Wilson Fisk's right-hand man and his closest friend. He runs the details of Fisk's empire until Karen Page kills him.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Jane Foster slaps Loki for the attack on New York when they finally meet. They escape Asgard together with Thor, and Loki fakes betraying her to Malekith as part of the plan to destroy the Aether.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Malekith hunts Jane Foster because the Aether, the weapon he needs to plunge the Nine Realms into darkness, has bonded with her. He draws it out of her on Svartalfheim, and Jane then helps Thor stop him during the Convergence in Greenwich.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Jane Foster and Thor fall in love after he lands in New Mexico.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Jane and Thor split up for years, and when they meet again she is wielding Mjolnir herself as the Mighty Thor.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Valkyrie fights beside Jane Foster after Jane takes up Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. They bond over battle and back each other up against Gorr.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Janelle Jackson is Simon Williams' agent at the Hanover Agency and finds him his early roles. They are friends as well as colleagues.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra, leader of the Quantum Realm's freedom fighters, distrusts Janet, a former member of their cause. They end up on the same side in the battle that brings Kang down.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Stranded in the Quantum Realm, Janet befriends Kang, who claims to be a lost traveler, and helps him repair his Time Sphere. When she learns what he truly is, she sabotages it to trap him there, and decades later she fights him again with her family.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Lord Krylar is Janet van Dyne's former lover. He reminds her of their past fling when they meet again in Axia.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: While trapped in the Quantum Realm, Janet reaches out through Scott, briefly taking over his body to guide her family to her. After her rescue, she helps send him back into the Quantum Realm to gather healing particles for Ghost.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Jason Quill is Meredith's father. He is at her bedside when she dies of cancer in 1988, and she gave her son Peter his name as a middle name.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Jason Quill is Peter Quill's grandfather, and he is at the hospital the night Peter's mother dies.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After decades away in space, Peter goes back to Earth to see his grandfather again.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate, greeting him with a racist remark. He keeps Wilkes under guard while Frost forces him to work on her Zero Matter experiments.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jason Wilkes is a scientist Peggy Carter meets in Los Angeles. They grow close and share feelings, though Peggy ends up choosing Daniel Sousa.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: The Council of Nine sends Rufus Hunt to get rid of Jason Wilkes as a loose end. Hunt tails Wilkes and Peggy Carter and ambushes them at the Griffith Observatory, but they escape.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney Frost kidnaps Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate and forces him to help with her Zero Matter experiments. When their atomic test reopens the rift, it is Wilkes, not Frost, who absorbs the extra Zero Matter.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Karen Page tries to get Jasper Evans to tell the press that Fisk paid him to stab him.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Matt Murdock tracks Jasper Evans down to learn the truth about the prison stabbing.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk sets up fellow inmate Jasper Evans to stab him, so he can strike a deal with the FBI. He later has Benjamin Poindexter kill Evans.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: As Nick Fury's deputy director, Maria Hill outranks Jasper Sitwell, and both work the Helicarrier's bridge during the hunt for Loki.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Sitwell is exposed as a HYDRA mole inside the agency Hill helped run.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell serves alongside Natasha at S.H.I.E.L.D. Once she and Steve learn he is Hydra, they abduct him and force him to reveal the truth about Project Insight.

stages.title: The Consultant
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell is one of Phil Coulson's trusted S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues, and together they scheme to sink the World Security Council's plan to recruit Emil Blonsky.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When HYDRA rises inside S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson learns that his old colleague Sitwell has been HYDRA all along.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson helps Steve and Natasha capture Jasper Sitwell, catching him in midair after Natasha kicks him off a roof.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell works alongside Steve Rogers at S.H.I.E.L.D., including on the Lemurian Star rescue. Once Steve learns Sitwell is HYDRA, he and Natasha force him to reveal Project Insight's targets.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell works at the Hub under Victoria Hand, greeting Coulson's team and tracking missions for her. When he is ordered to the Lemurian Star, Hand heads back to the Hub rather than take his place on the hunt.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean DeWolff investigates the crime lord Tombstone. Spider-Man hands her the evidence she needs, and she taunts Tombstone as he is taken into custody.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean DeWolff is Spider-Man's friend and contact in the NYPD. She feeds him intelligence on criminals and urges him to rest and find some human connection.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey frees Mac Gargan and takes control of his body to attack Damage Control.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey learns about MJ from Peter's letter to her and hunts her down to get to Spider-Man. She possesses MJ and uses her body to taunt him, even kissing him while pretending to remember him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey fights Spider-Man while searching for her sister and learns who he is. In the end, Peter takes a bullet for her and she uses her powers to keep him alive.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rebecca Kaplan is Jeff Kaplan's wife, and together they raise their son William.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace makes Jemma Simmons his special advisor on science and technology even though she does not trust him. She uses the post to grab as much control as she can so she can protect her friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and puts May in charge of training his new strike team. When a ghost's touch fills May with terror and she lashes out at everyone around her, Mace overpowers her with his super strength.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Phil Coulson helps choose Jeffrey Mace to lead S.H.I.E.L.D. when it becomes legal again, and serves under him. After Mace is exposed as not being an Inhuman, Coulson becomes Director in all but name, and the two stand together until Mace dies in the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Piper serves on the strike team under Director Jeffrey Mace and is picked to train him in combat when he needs to get stronger without his serum. She pins him to the ground in no time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace commandeers Zephyr One to arrest Ghost Rider and Quake, and Robbie nearly kills him. Mace stands up to the Ghost Rider but ends up helping stop Eli Morrow.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, kidnaps Director Jeffrey Mace and tortures him with his knives, sneering that S.H.I.E.L.D. is really a safe haven for Inhumans. Aida then replaces Mace with a Life Model Decoy and traps his mind in the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley, an Inhuman working with the Watchdogs, turns himself into a living bomb aimed at S.H.I.E.L.D., and Director Mace tackles him when he tries to explode again. After his capture, Shockley refuses to talk to anyone but Mace.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett joins Coulson's team on the mission to save Skye and earns their trust before he is exposed as Hydra's Clairvoyant. On his orders, Grant Ward dumps Jemma and Fitz into the ocean.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Kara Palamas comes over to S.H.I.E.L.D., Jemma Simmons and Fitz run test after test until they can confirm that Daniel Whitehall's brainwashing no longer controls her. Kara thanks them and asks Simmons about her own time undercover in Hydra.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Kasius forces Jemma Simmons to serve him on the Lighthouse as a slave. She later tries to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter nearly shoots Jemma in Morocco, not knowing she is Coulson's mole inside Hydra, until May stops him. Once Jemma comes home, the two become friends on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma Simmons and Leo Fitz are best friends from the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy and work side by side as Coulson's scientists. When Grant Ward drops them into the ocean, Fitz tells her he loves her and gives her the last of their air.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After a hard year apart, with Fitz hurt and Jemma undercover in HYDRA, Fitz never stops trying to bring her home from the planet Maveth. Once she is back, they finally become a couple.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Fitz follows the team into the future to find Jemma, and back home they marry. Then Fitz is killed in the battle against Glenn Talbot, though another Fitz still sleeps in cryostasis out in space.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Reunited, Fitz and Jemma secretly have a daughter, Alya, and hide her away while they finish the fight against the Chronicoms. Then they leave S.H.I.E.L.D. to raise her together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jemma Simmons questions Lincoln Campbell and enters him into S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Index, something he hates but accepts. She also helps Skye rescue him and Mike Peterson from Hydra's Arctic base.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May handpicks Jemma Simmons for Coulson's team, and the two become close friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Jemma has saved May's life before, curing her after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. When Izel fatally wounds May, Jemma freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury runs S.H.I.E.L.D. when Jemma joins Coulson's team. When Grant Ward drops her and Fitz into the ocean, Fury pulls them out and saves their lives, and she stays on to help rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D. as he asks.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Jemma Simmons and Leo Fitz to his team, and she becomes one of his most trusted agents and friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: As Director of the new S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson sends Jemma undercover inside HYDRA, and she keeps serving him as one of his closest agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: After Coulson's death, Jemma has a Life Model Decoy built that carries all his memories, and she brings the team to see it woken up.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jemma Simmons gets Piper out of the Playground before Aida's decoys destroy it and puts her on Zephyr One's guns.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper joins Jemma's long search through space to find Fitz and bring him home.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Fitz and Jemma trust Piper to guard the module where they keep their daughter safe while they finish their mission.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina spots Jemma leaving Hydra's labs, watches her report back to S.H.I.E.L.D., and blows her cover as a mole. Later Jemma fires at Raina's transformed body, but the bullets barely hurt her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Ghost Rider saves Jemma and Daisy when Hellfire turns on them and is about to kill them. They then work together to stop Eli Morrow from setting off a massive explosion.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales once hoped to recruit Jemma Simmons, and after his faction takes over the Playground, he hands her Coulson's Toolbox to crack with Anne Weaver. Jemma stays loyal to Coulson throughout the standoff.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale captures Jemma and Fitz and forces them to work on Hydra's Gravitonium project. Jemma warns her where it leads, having seen that future herself, but Ruby will not listen and later tries to kill her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Sinara takes Jemma Simmons into Kasius' service after seeing her treat a wounded servant. When Kasius decides that servant, Reese, is no longer perfect, Sinara executes him on his order, to Jemma's horror.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi is Jemma Simmons' superior while she spies inside HYDRA, and he never suspects she works for S.H.I.E.L.D. Later, when Jemma tries to kill Grant Ward, Bakshi steps in to save Ward and is killed by accident.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: The Doctor, the dark Hydra side of Fitz's mind, tortures Jemma Simmons inside a mental simulation.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley orders Jemma Simmons killed after she saves Vijay Nadeer during his Terrigenesis. She later goes up against Shockley herself in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s fight with the Watchdogs.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand puts Jemma Simmons and Trip to work at the Hub during the hunt for the Clairvoyant. When Hydra rises, Hand poses as Hydra and orders them to pledge their loyalty, a test the two pass by standing firm.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Will Daniels is an astronaut stranded on the planet Maveth, where Jemma Simmons is trapped with him for months. They fall for each other, but Hive kills him and takes his body.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Lilia Calderu and Jennifer Kale become friends while walking the Witches' Road. Lilia calls Jen "the High Priestess" when they meet.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rio Vidal walks the Witches' Road with Jennifer Kale as the coven's Green Witch before revealing that she is Death.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jennifer represents Leap-Frog in a lawsuit against his tailor Luke Jacobson. When he loses, he kidnaps Luke, and Jennifer helps rescue him.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Luke Jacobson is the superhero tailor who designs Jennifer's She-Hulk suit, after she opposes him in court.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Madisynn King testifies for Jennifer in Wong's case. The party-loving Madisynn then drags Jennifer into a night out, and they become friends.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Mallory Book is a rival attorney at GLK&H. She later represents Jennifer in her case against Titania.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt Murdock faces Jennifer in court over a superhero suit, then teams up with her against Leap-Frog. They spend a night together and date briefly while he is in town, and she brings him to meet her family.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris Walters is Jennifer's father. When she loses her job after becoming She-Hulk, he hosts a family dinner, tells her it will be okay, and jokes that at least she has not destroyed a city like her cousin Bruce.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos is Jennifer's paralegal and best friend, first at the district attorney's office and then at GLK&H. She pushes Jennifer to embrace She-Hulk, from stopping Titania in the courtroom to walking into a bar full of fans.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Skaar is Bruce Banner's son, making him Jennifer's cousin once removed. Bruce introduces him at a Walters family barbecue.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania brawls with Jennifer Walters and sues her over the trademark for the name She-Hulk.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Todd Phelps dates Jennifer Walters while secretly running Intelligencia, as HulkKing. He tries to steal her blood and expose her.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong first deals with Jennifer Walters when he is called as a witness at Emil Blonsky's parole hearing. He later hires her to sue Donny Blaze for misusing magic, and she wins him the case.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra leads the rebellion against Kang the Conqueror, who conquered her people.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra leads the freedom fighters, and the mind-reader Quaz is one of her fighters.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra, leader of the Quantum Realm's freedom fighters, captures Scott and Cassie Lang, then fights beside them against Kang.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra leads the Quantum Realm freedom fighters, with Veb among her fighters. She breaks him out of Kang's prison, and when Quantumnauts riddle him with holes during her final charge, Veb survives and finds he can use them to suck in enemies.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth is a lawyer who keeps hiring Jessica for investigations, and after Kilgrave's death she gets Jessica cleared of murder. The two have a prickly but lasting working relationship.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jeri takes on Gregory Sallinger, the serial killer Jessica is hunting, as her client and publicly defends his innocence.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy Meachum deals with Jeri as Danny's lawyer during the fight over Rand Enterprises.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth defends Hope Shlottman against a murder Kilgrave forced her to commit, then secretly frees Kilgrave hoping to use his power against her wife Wendy. The plan backfires, and he turns his control on Jeri and the people around her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Kith Lyonne was Jeri's girlfriend in college. Jeri tries to win her back years later, then manipulates Trish into going after Kith's husband.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm secretly records a meeting with Linda Chao to help Jeri Hogarth fight her law partners, and later takes on her cases as an investigator.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Malcolm works as Jeri's investigator at Hogarth & Associates, but he hates being her fixer, especially when she has him dig up dirt to wreck Kith Lyonne's marriage. In the end he quits after seeing how she operates.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Marci Stahl works as a lawyer at Jeri Hogarth's firm and recommends Foggy Nelson to her after Nelson and Murdock collapses. Jeri hires Foggy on Marci's word.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Samantha Reyes offers Jeri Hogarth a plea deal for her client Hope Shlottman.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth sets up Trish's radio interview with her client Hope Shlottman, and the two help Jessica hold Kilgrave captive.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jeri learns that Trish is the masked vigilante and manipulates her into going after Demetri Patseras for Kith's sake. When Trish becomes a fugitive, she takes Jeri's love Kith Lyonne hostage to force Jeri's help.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth hires Turk Barrett to get her an untraceable gun when she wants revenge on Inez Green and Shane Ryback. Turk is one of her clients, and after the deal she tells him she will need him again someday.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth takes on Danny Rand's fight to reclaim his place at Rand Enterprises against Ward and Joy Meachum, admitting she has a complicated history with Ward. Ward later comes to her claiming he has changed, just as his supposedly dead father Harold walks in.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wendell Rand gave Jeri her first job as an intern at Rand Enterprises.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Jessica reconnects with Karen Page, who asks her to look into the surviving crew of the Northern Star for the fight against Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Karl Malus is the IGH doctor who saved Jessica's life and gave her powers through experiments. She hunts him for answers and wants him dead for what he did to her mother.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave controlled Jessica's mind for months, and he raped her and forced her to kill. She finally breaks free and kills him by snapping his neck.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Kith Lyonne is Jeri Hogarth's former love. Jessica tries to stop Trish when Trish breaks into Jeri's apartment and holds Kith hostage.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica and Luke Cage become lovers, then split after he learns she killed his wife Reva under Kilgrave's control.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Jessica and Luke meet again when the Hand comes to New York, and they fight side by side as Defenders.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Jessica and Luke are together again and have a daughter named Danielle. Luke takes CIA work to keep his family off the agency's radar and comes home to them when it ends.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao is one of the Hand's leaders, and she and Jessica Jones clash at Midland Circle. When Gao hurls concrete blocks at the Defenders, Jessica kicks them right back at her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica is Malcolm's neighbor, and she helps him get clean after Kilgrave turns him into an addict. He becomes her closest friend and stands by her against Kilgrave.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm becomes Jessica's partner at Alias Investigations, but he goes behind her back to help Trish find Karl Malus, then leaves to work for Pryce Cheng and Jeri Hogarth.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica and Malcolm team up again to stop Gregory Sallinger and then Trish. When it is over, Jessica hands him the key to Alias Investigations.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Matt Murdock is Jessica's lawyer and her fellow Defender.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Years later Matt recruits Jessica to dig into Wilson Fisk, and she becomes part of his resistance.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Misty Knight works with Jessica and the other Defenders against the Hand. She keeps an eye on them for the NYPD while fighting at their side.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA operative who tries to recruit Jessica, and she turns him down. His agents later attack her home.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami tries to kidnap Trish Walker so the Hand can trade her for Sowande, and Jessica Jones fights him to protect her. He nearly stabs Jessica before he slips away.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Oscar Arocho is Jessica's neighbor and the building superintendent. They become close and start dating.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Things don't work out between Jessica and Oscar, and they agree to end their romance on good terms.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Detective Oscar Clemons questions Jessica about the Kilgrave case and comes to believe her. Will Simpson later kills him while trying to get to Kilgrave.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Under Kilgrave's control, Jessica kills Reva Connors, who is Luke Cage's wife.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Samantha Reyes pushes Jessica Jones's client Hope Shlottman to take a plea deal.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Stick briefs Jessica Jones and the other Defenders on the Hand's history.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica is Trish's adoptive sister and has been her best friend for most of their lives. Trish stands by her through the fight with Kilgrave.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish grows envious of Jessica's powers and forces Karl Malus to give her powers of her own. Then she kills Jessica's mother, Alisa, and the sisters are estranged.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: The sisters reunite once Trish becomes a vigilante, but after their mother Dorothy is murdered, Trish turns into a killer. Jessica stops her escape and turns her in to the police.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Vido Arocho is Oscar's young son and Jessica's neighbor. He looks up to her, and she protects him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Will Simpson is a police sergeant whom Kilgrave sends to kill Trish. He then sides with Jessica against Kilgrave, but he turns violent on combat drugs and becomes her enemy.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Jessica investigates Mayor Wilson Fisk's corruption for Matt Murdock and joins the resistance against him.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Morris is Jiang Li's loyal companion from Ta Lo, who stays with Wenwu's family after she leaves her village.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jiang Li is Shang-Chi's mother. She is killed by his father's enemies when he is a boy, and he trains in her Ta Lo fighting style years later.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jiang Li is Wenwu's wife. She meets him when he tries to break into Ta Lo, and for her he gives up the Ten Rings.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jiang Li is Xialing's mother, killed by her father's enemies when Xialing is a child.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jiang Li and Ying Nan are sisters who grow up together in Ta Lo. After Li's death, Nan welcomes her sister's children, Shang-Chi and Xialing, to the village and trains them in its fighting style.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying welcomes Lincoln Campbell to Afterlife, grants him Terrigenesis, and later assigns him to guide and watch over her daughter Skye. He sides with her at first, but turns against her after seeing her kill innocent agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying agrees to make peace with Phil Coulson, then secretly turns her people against S.H.I.E.L.D. and starts a war. Coulson stops her plan to spread Terrigen across the world, losing his hand in the process.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying takes Raina into Afterlife after her transformation and is fascinated by her new visions of the future. When Raina sets out to expose Jiaying's plan to wipe out humanity, she provokes Jiaying into killing her so Skye will see the truth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales comes to Afterlife to negotiate with Jiaying, and she kills him with a Terrigen crystal. She then shoots herself with his gun to make it look like S.H.I.E.L.D. attacked her.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jim Morita is freed from a HYDRA prison camp by Steve Rogers and joins the Howling Commandos under his command. He fights with Steve across Europe until the war's end.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Jim Paxton recognizes Scott's van horn outside Pym Technologies and pulls Kurt and Dave out of the van. Kurt still manages to trigger his part of the plan on his laptop before he is cuffed.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Jim Paxton is engaged to Maggie, Scott's ex-wife, and together they raise her daughter Cassie in San Francisco.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Jim Paxton is the police officer engaged to Scott's ex-wife Maggie and the stepfather of his daughter Cassie. He distrusts Scott and arrests him after the break-in at Hank Pym's house, but comes to respect him after Scott saves Cassie from Yellowjacket.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Jimmy Woo meets Monica outside Westview and shows her a card trick. They work together with Darcy Lewis to figure out what Wanda has done to the town.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Jimmy Woo is the FBI agent watching over Scott's house arrest, always hoping to catch him breaking it. Scott stays one step ahead of him, and Woo picks up a card trick from him along the way.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Jimmy Woo works with S.W.O.R.D. on the Westview case under Tyler Hayward, who brushes off his concerns. Woo and Darcy Lewis later foil Hayward's plans, and he is arrested.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Joaquin Torres gathers intel on Karli Morgenthau and her Flag Smashers and helps Sam and Bucky hunt them.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Sam has Joaquin Torres look into Ruth Bat-Seraph. She later saves Joaquin and Sam from mind-controlled soldiers at Camp Echo One and works with them.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Joaquin Torres is an Air Force lieutenant who helps Sam Wilson hunt the Flag Smashers and becomes his friend.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Once Sam becomes Captain America, Joaquin takes over as the new Falcon and flies at his side as his best friend and wingman.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Samuel Sterns is behind the White House attack, and Joaquin helps Sam track him down. Sterns' plot puts Joaquin's own life in danger.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Joaquin Torres fights Sidewinder's men alongside Sam Wilson. After Sidewinder attacks Sam, Joaquin traces his phone.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: President Thaddeus Ross invites Joaquin and Sam to the White House as guests of honor after they recover the adamantium. When Ross orders them to stand down, they go off on their own.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lance Hunter helps Daisy and Mack rescue Joey Gutierrez from the ATCU in Seattle. On later missions he cheerfully warns Joey that every plan eventually turns to rubbish.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Joey Gutierrez and Lincoln Campbell are fellow Inhumans in Daisy's Secret Warriors. Sent on their first mission into Hydra's castle, Joey asks why them, and Lincoln guesses they are all S.H.I.E.L.D. has.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Phil Coulson sends Daisy, Lance Hunter, and Mack to rescue Joey Gutierrez when his powers emerge, and he has Andrew Garner assess Joey for Daisy's Secret Warriors. Joey later helps rescue Coulson and Fitz from Hydra's castle.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Victor Ramon calls in S.H.I.E.L.D. about weapons stolen from his police, and Joey Gutierrez and Daisy Johnson meet him at his station. When Ramon turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and arrests its agents, Joey melts his officers' guns during the rescue.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff performs throat surgery on Leviathan agents like Leet Brannis before they are sent to America.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff poses as Dr. Ivchenko, a Soviet defector Peggy Carter rescues, to infiltrate the SSR. She stops his plan.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff hypnotizes SSR chief Roger Dooley, who dies wearing a bomb vest to protect his men.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff performs throat surgery on Leviathan agents like Sasha Demidov before they are sent to America.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett teases Fitz with gallows humor on the mission to save Skye, before he is exposed as Hydra's Clairvoyant. In the final battle, Fitz hits him with an EMP device that wrecks his cybernetics and leaves him near death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett works alongside May's team as a trusted senior agent until he is exposed as the Clairvoyant and the head of Hydra's Centipede program. May then helps the team bring him down at Cybertek.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett turns Mike Peterson into Deathlok, his cyborg enforcer, and keeps him obedient by threatening his son Ace. When Skye tells Mike that Ace is safe, Mike turns on Garrett and crushes his skull.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury oversees John Garrett's training as his supervising officer in the early days of S.H.I.E.L.D. Garrett secretly becomes HYDRA's Clairvoyant, and Fury shows up at Cybertek to help Coulson's team take him down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett and Phil Coulson were partners and friends at S.H.I.E.L.D. for years. Garrett turns out to be the Clairvoyant and Hydra, and Coulson kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina works for John Garrett, the Clairvoyant, on the Centipede project.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett and Victoria Hand once served together in Lisbon, and he jokes that she is a buzzkill at parties. When he is exposed as the Clairvoyant, Hand takes him into custody to send him to the Fridge, and Grant Ward kills her on the way.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Matt Murdock defends John Healy in court, then catches him as Daredevil and forces Fisk's name out of him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett sells John Healy, a hitman working for Wilson Fisk, a brand new handgun and swears it won't jam. Healy grumbles that he prefers a good revolver.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: John Healy is a hitman Fisk hires to carry out a killing. When Daredevil catches him, Healy names Fisk and then kills himself rather than face Fisk's revenge.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Anderson and Eliza Schultz pay for the care of John Pilgrim's dying wife and send him to kill for them. They hold his sons over him to keep him loyal.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: John Walker hunts Karli Morgenthau and blames her for Lemar Hoskins' death.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lemar Hoskins is John Walker's best friend from the Army. He serves as Battlestar beside Walker's Captain America.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: The government hands Steve's shield to John Walker after Sam gives it up, and the two clash over how to handle the Flag Smashers. When Walker kills a Flag Smasher in public, Sam and Bucky take the shield back from him.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Taskmaster is sent to the O.X.E. vault to kill John Walker. She attacks him before Ghost kills her.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine recruits John Walker as U.S. Agent after he loses the shield.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina sends Walker to an O.X.E. vault to die so he can't expose her secrets.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: John Walker is sent to kill Yelena in an O.X.E. vault, and they fight until they realize Valentina has set them all up to die there. They escape together and end up teammates on the New Avengers, with Yelena as their leader.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Mole Man is a former enemy of Johnny's team who helps them during the crisis with Galactus.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Johnny Storm is Reed's brother-in-law and teammate in the Fantastic Four.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Johnny Storm decodes the Silver Surfer's messages and is drawn to her. She first fights the Fantastic Four, then turns against Galactus to save Earth.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Johnny Storm is Sue's younger brother and teammate in the Fantastic Four.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jon Jon greets Shang-Chi at the Golden Daggers Club, Xialing's fight club in Macau, and is a big fan of his fighting.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Jon Jon works for Xialing at the Golden Daggers Club, her underground fight club in Macau.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi is Whitney Frost's mob partner and stands against Peggy Carter through Frost's Zero Matter scheme. When Frost spins out of control, he reluctantly teams up with Peggy to stop her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi is Whitney Frost's former lover from her early days. He helps her again after her husband's death.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Josie hides Karen and Matt at her bar when Fisk's task force hunts them.

stages.title: Daredevil S1

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Lucian Aster is a former Master of Kamar-Taj who follows Kaecilius into the Zealots. He helps steal the ritual from the Book of Cagliostro and dies fighting Stephen Strange at the New York Sanctum.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Kaecilius tries to kill Stephen Strange, and Strange defeats him by bargaining with Dormammu.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Kaecilius was once one of the Ancient One's most gifted students, but he turns on her as a hypocrite after learning she draws power from the Dark Dimension. He leads his Zealots against her and fatally wounds her.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Kaecilius kills Wong at the Hong Kong Sanctum, and Stephen Strange turns back time to bring him back.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Kareem, the Red Dagger, first fights Kamala in Karachi but becomes her friend and ally against the Clandestines.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala Khan tracks down Kate Bishop at her apartment and recruits her into a new team of young heroes.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala and Monica's powers become entangled with Carol's, so the three swap places whenever they use them. They team up as the Marvels to stop Dar-Benn.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Muneeba Khan is Kamala's strict but loving mother. She eventually accepts Kamala's powers and makes her a costume.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Najma, leader of the Clandestines, wants Kamala Khan's bangle to open the way back to the Noor dimension, and she turns on Kamala when she resists. In the end Najma sacrifices herself to close the Veil.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir has been one of Kamala's best friends since their earliest school days. Kamala talks her into running for the mosque board, and Nakia makes her campaign manager.

stages.title: The Marvels

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sadie Deever leads Damage Control's hunt for the masked hero Night Light, who is Kamala, and her agents chase Kamala and her friends.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sana is Kamala's grandmother in Karachi. She tells Kamala about her family's past and understands her better than anyone.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sheikh Abdullah, the imam at Kamala's mosque, gives her advice about doing good and later stands up for her community against Damage Control.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Tyesha Hillman marries Kamala's brother Aamir, making her Kamala's sister-in-law.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Waleed, the leader of the Red Daggers, explains to Kamala the truth about her bangle and her family's past.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Yusuf Khan is Kamala's father. He explains that her name means wonder, and calls her his little Ms. Marvel.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Kamala Khan saves Zoe Zimmer during the AvengerCon chaos, and the once popular classmate later becomes her friend.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Kamala asks Kareem to train Kamran after he comes to Karachi, and Kareem agrees.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sheikh Abdullah hides Kamran from Damage Control at the mosque and stalls the agents so he can escape.

stages.text: Lord Krylar, Janet van Dyne's old lover in the Quantum Realm, switches sides and pledges his loyalty to Kang. When Janet comes to him for help, he sells her and her family out to Kang.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter knocks out Agent 33 just before she can execute Skye in Vancouver. Later Kara and Grant Ward kidnap and torture Hunter's ex-wife Bobbi, and Hunter comes to her rescue.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Disguised as Melinda May, Agent 33 slips onto the Bus and plants a virus that knocks out its systems. Later, during an uneasy alliance with Grant Ward, Kara holds a knife to Fitz's throat until Ward calms everyone down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Kara Palamas wears Melinda May's face to infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D. and fights her.

stages.text: Deathlok holds Kara Palamas hostage in Tijuana so Coulson can force Grant Ward into a meeting. During the uneasy alliance that follows, Deathlok keeps watch over the couple and even tells them to stop kissing.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Phil Coulson asks Agent Kara Palamas to come back, but HYDRA abducts and brainwashes her first. As Agent 33 she fights Coulson's team for Daniel Whitehall and later for Grant Ward.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Kara Palamas works at Sunil Bakshi's side as a Hydra assassin after his team kidnaps and brainwashes her. Together they capture Melinda May, and Kara takes May's face to fool her team.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Waleed leads the Red Daggers and has trained Kareem as his apprentice and friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Tony Stark builds Karen, the AI inside the Spider-Man suit he gives Peter Parker. She stays locked behind Tony's Training Wheels Protocol until Peter and Ned hack it open.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie, Matt's law partner, defends Karen in court when Fisk's government puts her on trial for vigilantism, and helps win her freedom.

stages.title: The Punisher S1

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen delivers the Charter of the Port of Red Hook to Governor Marge McCaffrey, who is working to remove Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Matt and Foggy help clear Karen Page of a murder she did not commit, and she joins their firm out of gratitude. She becomes Matt's close friend as she digs into Wilson Fisk's crimes.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen and Matt start a romance, but his secret life pulls them apart. After the firm shuts down, he reveals to her that he is Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Karen refuses to believe Matt died at Midland Circle, and when he comes back, she works with him and Foggy to bring Fisk down.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: After Foggy's death Karen leaves New York, but she comes back to build a resistance with Matt against Mayor Fisk, and they rekindle their romance. When Fisk puts her on trial, Matt helps win her freedom.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Mitchell Ellison is Karen's editor at the New York Bulletin, and he hires her as a reporter.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ellison clashes with Karen over her crusade to put Fisk back in prison, and she loses her job after Poindexter's attack on the Bulletin. In the end he still releases the video that exposes Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu Yoshioka has the Hand kidnap Karen Page and others Daredevil has saved, holding them as bait to lure him out. Matt Murdock tracks them down and frees the hostages.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem turns against Fisk and works with Karen, Matt and Foggy to bring him down.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen Page interviews Ray Schoonover, Frank Castle's old commander, while digging into Frank's past. Schoonover is secretly the Blacksmith, and he tries to kill her to cover his tracks before Frank saves her.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen Page uncovers Samantha Reyes's role in the cover-up around the Castle family's deaths.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen Page helps rescue Soledad Ayala after Fisk's task force arrests her.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Karen Page uncovers Wilson Fisk's crimes from her first days in Hell's Kitchen, and she kills his right-hand man, James Wesley.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Once the FBI frees Fisk, Karen works to put him back in prison. She taunts him with the truth about Wesley's death, and Fisk sends Poindexter to kill her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: When Fisk becomes mayor, he has Karen arrested and put on trial for vigilantism.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm recognizes Karl Malus's ring as one from his own old college and digs into his past for Jessica. He later goes behind her back to help Trish track Malus to a motel, where Trish knocks him out and takes Malus herself.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish Walker kidnaps Karl Malus and forces him to give her powers.

stages.title: Doctor Strange

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Karl Mordo is the Ancient One's devoted student until he discovers she draws power from the Dark Dimension.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Wong and Karl Mordo serve together as masters of Kamar-Taj. They catch Strange meddling with time through the Eye of Agamotto and scold him together, and both fight Kaecilius's Zealots before Mordo walks away from the order.

stages.text: Karli Morgenthau calls Sarah Wilson in the middle of the night and threatens her to get to Sam.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Wilfred Nagel recreated the super soldier serum that Karli Morgenthau steals.

stages.text: Kate Bishop discovers that Wilson Fisk is behind her mother's crimes. She fights him at Rockefeller Center and knocks him down with a trick arrow.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Yelena Belova comes to New York to kill Clint Barton for her sister's death and clashes with Kate Bishop along the way. The two later share mac and cheese and part on friendly terms.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2

stages.text: Kazi befriends Maya as a child at karate class, where she teaches him sign language, and grows up to be her second-in-command in the Tracksuit Mafia. When he comes to bring her back to Fisk, she kills him.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kazi works in the Tracksuit Mafia under Fisk's rule and serves as Maya Lopez's second-in-command.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Kebo tortures Werner von Strucker on Ward's orders. Later the two briefly work together, and Kebo tries to kill him.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Mantis travels to Earth with Drax and kidnaps Kevin Bacon, using her powers on him, as a Christmas gift for Peter Quill. Bacon ends up celebrating Christmas with the Guardians on Knowhere.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Kevin Bacon is Peter Quill's childhood hero. Mantis and Drax bring him to Knowhere as a Christmas present for Quill.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Khonshu is the Egyptian moon god who saves Marc from death and makes him his avatar, the Moon Knight. Marc serves him reluctantly and wants to be free of him.

stages.title: Loki S1

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: President Loki plots with Boastful Loki to seize Kid Loki's throne. His army storms Kid Loki's bunker and the Lokis turn on one another.

stages.text: Kilgrave uses his control over others to torment Trish and nearly have her killed in his war on Jessica.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave orders Will Simpson to kill Trish Walker. Simpson later tries to kill Kilgrave.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Linda is Erik Killmonger's girlfriend and partner in crime. He shoots her to get to Klaue.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Erik Killmonger is N'Jobu's son. As a boy, he finds his father murdered by King T'Chaka.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Erik Killmonger's raid on the CIA site to free Ulysses Klaue nearly kills Nakia before Everett Ross shields her. When Killmonger takes the throne, she saves the last Heart-Shaped Herb to bring T'Challa back and fights Killmonger alongside Shuri.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Erik Killmonger wins the throne, Okoye stands by him out of duty to the crown even as she argues against his plans for war. Once T'Challa returns alive, she turns on Killmonger and fights him with the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Erik Killmonger is the son of Ramonda's late brother-in-law N'Jobu, which makes him her nephew by marriage. She rejects his claim to the throne, then has to flee Wakanda after he defeats her son T'Challa at Warrior Falls.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Erik Killmonger is Shuri's cousin. He tries to kill her when he takes the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Shuri takes the Heart-Shaped Herb, she meets Erik on the Ancestral Plane, and he urges her to take revenge.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: T'Chaka is Killmonger's uncle. He killed Erik's father N'Jobu in Oakland and left the boy behind, setting Erik on his path to take Wakanda's throne.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Erik Killmonger is T'Challa's cousin. He beats T'Challa for the throne, and T'Challa defeats and fatally wounds him.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Erik Killmonger is a cousin of T'Challa, Toussaint's father, which makes him Toussaint's first cousin once removed. Erik dies in his fight for the throne before Toussaint is born.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ulysses Klaue works with Erik Killmonger, and then Killmonger kills him to win his way into Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi wants justice for his parents, whom Ulysses Klaue killed, so when Erik Killmonger arrives in Wakanda with Klaue's body, W'Kabi brings him before the council. He backs Erik as king and leads the Border Tribe in Erik's fight against T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri watched Killmonger's father N'Jobu die and helped T'Chaka keep it secret. When Killmonger comes to Wakanda, Zuri steps in to protect T'Challa and Killmonger kills him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi visits Kingo on his film set in Mumbai to recruit him. He travels with her but refuses to fight in the final battle.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite is Kingo's close friend. Kingo refuses to fight her or anyone else in the final battle.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie is Matt Murdock's law partner at Murdock & McDuffie and his best friend. She watches over him after Foggy's death.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie represents Soledad Ayala's husband Hector and supports her through his trial.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie, Matt's partner at Murdock and McDuffie, takes on the cases that put her against Mayor Fisk's anti-vigilante crackdown.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk strikes back by raiding her law office and freezing its accounts. She works with Matt to find witnesses who can prove Fisk's crimes and remove him from office.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: While on the run, Trish breaks into Jeri Hogarth's apartment and holds Kith Lyonne hostage to force Jeri to help her escape.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox and Uzman work side by side in Sonny Burch's crew. Together they take Luis, Kurt and Dave hostage at X-Con Security so Uzman can dose Luis with his truth serum.

stages.text: Korath chases Peter Quill for the Orb on Morag, and they try to kill each other.

stages.text: Korath the Pursuer leaves Starforce to become Ronan the Accuser's loyal enforcer. Ronan sends him to Morag for the Orb, and Korath stays at his side on the Dark Aster until Drax kills him.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Korath serves in Starforce under Yon-Rogg's command during the Kree war with the Skrulls. Yon-Rogg leads him and the team to Torfa to rescue the Kree spy Soh-Larr, and later to Earth to bring back Carol Danvers.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok

stages.text: Korg is one of the Grandmaster's gladiators who starts a revolution against him.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Korg befriends Thor in the gladiator pits of Sakaar and joins his revolt against the Grandmaster.

stages.text: Korg follows Thor to New Asgard and fights at his side again against Gorr, even after Zeus blasts his body apart.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Korg and Valkyrie both join Thor's revolt on Sakaar and settle in New Asgard with the surviving Asgardians. They fight side by side against Gorr.

stages.text: Zeus throws his thunderbolt at Korg in Omnipotence City, blowing apart Korg's body and leaving only his head.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kraglin pilots Knowhere through a jump point to the High Evolutionary's Arête Laboratories, arriving to his horror to help the Guardians rescue their friends and the captive children.
